name: curlshot
description: Hosted MCP server for CurlShot. Takes screenshots of any public web page as PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF or a scrolling video (MP4, WebM, GIF), with device presets, full-page capture, dark mode, element selectors and ad and cookie banner blocking.

CURLSHOT_API_KEY.description: CurlShot API key. The free plan includes 100 screenshots a month, no card needed: https://curlshot.com/register

http.description: Hosted streamable HTTP endpoint with Bearer auth

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Renders a public web page and returns it as an image, a PDF, or a video of the page scrolling.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: Lists the device presets (phones, tablets, desktops) that take_screenshot accepts in viewport_device.

examples.title: Screenshot a website
examples.description: Capture the first screen of a page and return it as an image

examples.title: Mobile full-page capture
examples.description: Render the whole page on a phone preset
examples.prompt: Take a full-page screenshot of https://example.com on an iPhone 15 Pro
